title: Configuration: appsettings, Environment Variables and Tenants | Orchard Core
description:
An Orchard Core site reads its settings from several places, and each tenant can add settings of its own. Without knowing which source wins, or where a tenant's values live, a setting that has no effect is hard to explain.

Orchard Core extends the ASP.NET Core configuration with IShellConfiguration. Its settings sit under the OrchardCore section, can be set in a file or an environment variable, and can be overridden for one tenant when a module reads them per tenant.

In this video:
• Configuration sections: everything sits under OrchardCore
• Environment variables: the same settings, without a file
• Which value wins: the sources, in the order they load
• Tenant configuration: before and after a tenant exists
• One database for every tenant: shared settings at the root
• Configuration in your module: read a section, describe it
